offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures pumps and pump systems for moving water, wastewater and other fluids. Sells to municipal, industrial, construction, fire protection, agriculture and OEM customers, mainly through distributors.

primary_products.value: centrifugal pumps; self-priming pumps; submersible pumps; booster and lift stations; fire protection pump systems

customer_segment.value: B2B: industrial companies, contractors, OEMs, distributors, utilities; B2G: municipalities for water and wastewater systems

end_markets.value: water and wastewater; construction; fire protection; industrial; agriculture; petroleum

revenue_model.value: product sales: pumps, pump systems and replacement parts

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: manufactures pumps from castings and components, sold to distributors, contractors and municipalities

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Europe, Africa, Middle East and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: various pump types and pump systems for water, wastewater, fire and industrial uses

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: independent pump distributors and dealers; direct sales: OEMs, municipalities and large project customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: product standards such as NSF/ANSI 61 drinking water, UL/FM fire pump approvals, environmental and trade rules
